Package bakerydms

Class Theme

  • java.lang.Object
    • bakerydms.Theme
  • public class Theme
extends java.lang.Object
    The look of the program: colors, fonts and ready-styled Swing components.

    BakeryOrderWindow creates every button, label and text box through this class, so the whole window keeps the same bakery colors (raspberry, cream and dark brown) and fonts. Changing a color here changes it everywhere. The fonts are picked from what the computer has installed, with standard Java fonts as a fallback.

    Version:
    4.0 (Phase 4, Module 11)
    Author:
    Kayla Ewing
